name: patchwork

scripts.clean: rm -rf build out dist-electron dist-server test-results .e2e
scripts.check: svelte-kit sync && npm run paraglide && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json
scripts.check:watch: svelte-kit sync && npm run paraglide && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json --watch
scripts.test: npm run test:unit -- --run && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e: playwright install chromium && npm run build && npm run server:build && playwright test
scripts.cap:android: npm run cap:sync && cap open android
scripts.cap:ios: npm run cap:sync && cap open ios
scripts.electron:dev: npm run electron:compile && concurrently -k -n vite,esbuild,electron "vite dev --port 5173 --strictPort" "node electron/build.mjs --watch" "wait-on tcp:5173 && electron . --dev-url=http://localhost:5173"
scripts.electron:start: npm run build && npm run electron:compile && electron .
scripts.electron:package: npm run build && npm run electron:compile && electron-forge package
scripts.electron:make: npm run build && npm run electron:compile && electron-forge make
scripts.test:electron: npm run build && npm run electron:compile && playwright test --config electron/playwright.config.ts
scripts.server:dev: npm run build && npm run server:build && node dist-server/server.mjs
scripts.electron:sandbox: concurrently -k -n sandbox,app "node dev/sandbox.ts" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:4010 && GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=.sandbox/gitconfig PATCHWORK_GITHUB_WEB_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4010 PATCHWORK_GITHUB_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4010 PATCHWORK_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID=Iv23liSandbox npm run electron:dev"
scripts.server:local: npm run build && npm run server:build && PATCHWORK_LOCAL=1 node dist-server/server.mjs

description: Describe a change once and get reviewed pull requests across your repositories.
author: Patchwork
